description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Slovenian language messages for UI elements and errors.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message for loading error during search.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message indicating that input is too long, specifying characters to delete.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message indicating that input is too short, specifying characters to add.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message indicating maximum number of items user can select.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Slovenian message when searching is in progress.
